description: Candidate access modes from the thread that produced the tier separation. NOT members of the access tier. Each needs breaks_when written before it enters, because an access entry with no stated break point is a preference rather than an access mode and is rejected at validation. The leading underscore keeps this file out of the tier the way ontology/_vocab.json stays out of the entity set.
status: candidates — none of these has a stated break point yet
gate: write breaks_when, then move the record into ontology/access/aNN-<name>.json

candidates.name: residual
candidates.sketch: the world pushes back on your own reading

candidates.name: transmission
candidates.sketch: taught or given. Carries the source's observer, not the receipts

candidates.name: borrowed-instrument
candidates.sketch: read another observer's response rather than the world directly

candidates.name: derivative-read
candidates.sketch: read CHANGE in an uninterpretable channel. No decoder required

provenance.note: candidate list and sketches quoted from the tier separation spec; no field here was written during the build
